story_thesis: Smucker's 52% adjusted EPS jump rests almost entirely on U.S. Retail Coffee margins and one-off IEEPA tariff refunds that are now essentially finished; its own guidance implies second-half adjusted EPS 26-32% below the first half.

Analog Devices, HP, Autodesk, Best Buy, Burlington, Li Auto and PDD were reviewed but not chosen today to keep sector rotation (HP overlaps Dell's PC exposure) or because the 6-K exhibit was not a results release (PDD).
